title: Study on the active components and mechanism of Atractylodis Macrocephalae Rhizoma for invigorating the spleen and tonifying qi based on spectrum-effect relationship and network pharmacology.
authors: Li, Yafei; Tang, Lulu; Zhao, Mingfang; Tang, Rui; Fang, Keer; Ge, Weihong; Du, Weifeng
one_liner_zh: 该文基于谱效关系和网络药理学研究白术健脾益气活性成分，分子对接仅用于验证，核心对象为中药成分与靶蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Spleen deficiency can lead to various abnormal physiological functions of the spleen. Atractylodis Macrocephalae Rhizoma (AMR) is a traditional Chinese medicine used to invigorate the spleen and tonify qi. The study aimed to identify the primary active components influencing the efficacy of AMR in strengthening the spleen and replenishing qi through spectrum-effect relationship and chemometrics. Network pharmacology was used to investigate the mechanism by which AMR strengthens the spleen and replenishes qi, with molecular docking utilized for validation purposes. The findings indicated that bran-fried AMR exhibited superior efficacy, with atractylenolides and atractylone identified as the primary active constituents. Atractylenolide II emerged as the most influential component impacting the effectiveness of AMR, while the key target was androgen receptor. Furthermore, crucial pathways implicated included the mitogen-activated protein cascade (MAPK) cascade, RNA polymerase II transcription factor activity, ligand-activated sequence-specific DNA binding, and RNA polymerase II sequence-specific DNA-binding transcription factor binding. In summary, our study has identified the primary active components associated with the efficacy of AMR and has provided an initial exploration of its mechanism of action. This offers a theoretical foundation for future investigations into the material basis and molecular mechanisms underlying the pharmacodynamics of AMR.
abstract_zh: 脾虚可导致脾脏多种异常生理功能。白术（Atractylodis Macrocephalae Rhizoma, AMR）是一种用于健脾益气的传统中药。本研究旨在通过谱效关系和化学计量学方法，识别影响AMR健脾益气功效的主要活性成分。采用网络药理学研究AMR健脾益气的机制，并利用分子对接进行验证。结果表明，麸炒AMR表现出更优的功效，其中苍术内酯类化合物和苍术酮被确定为主要活性成分。苍术内酯II是对AMR功效影响最大的成分，而关键靶点为雄激素受体。此外，涉及的关键通路包括丝裂原活化蛋白激酶（MAPK）级联反应、RNA聚合酶II转录因子活性、配体激活的序列特异性DNA结合，以及RNA聚合酶II序列特异性DNA结合转录因子结合。总之，本研究识别了与AMR功效相关的主要活性成分，并初步探索了其作用机制，为未来研究AMR药效的物质基础及分子机制提供了理论基础。
